invariants.contract: Socket.IO user_stream_update carries one object {id, username, type, session, lastSeen, createdAt} of the acting user where session is that user's own open session as toJSONForClient (libraryItem null), and is sent to every admin socket and no non-admin socket: once on a play, once on a close (the session is still the closing one, with its listening time, or 0 for a session that never listened), twice in order (previous session, then new session) when a play replaces a same-device session; a refused play or close emits none.
